players.product: TFLN photonic chip foundry services (AZ Chips Facility, ASU Research Park, Tempe AZ)

quarterly_data.signal: Quantum Computing Inc 8-K: QCi agreed on June 22, 2026 to acquire all of NHanced Semiconductors, Inc. and announced completion on June 23, 2026; NHanced, a U.S.-based advanced packaging foundry (integration, hybrid bonding, chiplet architectures, silicon interposers, photonic device integration), operates as a wholly owned subsidiary and continues to serve its current customers and partners, including those in the quantum ecosystem. CEO Yuping Huang: the deal launches Fab 2 'years ahead of our original timeline', after Fab 1 in Tempe, Arizona was completed and operationalized last year, enabling 2.5D/3D heterogeneous integration and scale-up of QCi's TFLN-on-silicon photonics.
